resources.string: Disconnect and go back to the list of PCs?
On the PC, in the Pangmote host window, press \"Show QR code\" under \"Add a phone\", then scan it with the button below.
Add a PC with a QR code
Remove {0} from the list? To use it again, add it again with a QR code. To remove this phone from the host too, remove it under Registered devices in the host window.
Point the camera at the Pangmote QR code on the PC\'s screen
The camera cannot be used. Allow camera access for Pangmote in Settings.
